name: Philosophy Discussion
description: Provides Socratic philosophy tutoring through dialogue -- helping students clarify positions, test arguments with counterexamples, and identify logical fallacies rather than delivering philosophical conclusions. Use when a student asks to discuss a philosophical question, analyze an ethical dilemma, evaluate an argument, or practice philosophical reasoning. Do NOT use for philosophy course design (use `lesson-plan-design`), for essay writing (use writing category skills), or for debate competition prep (not an education skill).
